restrictions: RANDOMIZED matcher (not fixed-witness): searches own first blocks M0(i); returns two-block ordinary collisions on sha256-r31-prefix-v1. Published ASIACRYPT pair returned only negligibly.

Li-Liu-Wang EUROCRYPT 2024 Table 6 characteristic and one public starting point are treated as PUBLIC PUBLISHED algorithm parameters restated in proof.md (like round constants), not as outputs of a participant-timed SAT search charged via a score-critical historical heuristic.
Online: 2560-entry A(-1)-keyed table built in-run from that public starting point (charged in preprocessing <= 2^30.1); four W5 classes; B=2^48 first blocks; caps 4096 matches / 2^34 hits (Markov).
Every returned pair re-verified by complete selected-target re-hash. Heuristics H-UNIFORM and H-STEP3 only (both organizer-experiment-backed). No H-HISTORICAL-COST.
Pricing collision-frontier-v5 C=2140. Declared time_log2=48.1 from T <= 2^48*(1+128/2140) + 2^30.1 + 2^33 + 2^27 with log2(T)~48.084. No fabricated 41.
Four organizer experiments: fresh-completions, table-replay, real-state-completion, match-word-uniformity. Empty certificate manifest.
baseline_improved is the required nominal reference sha256-r31-nominal-v2 only.
Exploratory: not full-scale 2^48 execution; not rigorous qualification; not 32-round/full SHA-256.

heuristics.statement: For distinct first blocks M0(i), the chaining words (h0, h1, h2) = (A-1, A-2, A-3) of f(IV, M0(i)) have the probabilities of independent uniform words for the table-entry match events and their same-key intersections (2^-45.678 full matches per block, exact overlap 0.000233 * 2^-48), and blocks are independent; with H-STEP3 this gives per-block success probability at least 2^-48 * 0.5247. The caps use only the marginals (Markov).
heuristics.scope: The 31-round compression from the standard IV on 2^48 counter-indexed first blocks; events defined by 32-bit equalities and set memberships on the output words.
heuristics.extrapolation: Standard modelling assumption of two-block attacks. Organizer experiment match-word-uniformity tests single events on the attack block family; real-state-completion and author reduced-scale joint tests support free-word behaviour. The full 2^-46 event is extrapolated.
heuristics.limitations: The full-match event (~2^-46 per block) is not observed directly; reduced-scale tests cover single-word events and joints to ~2^-25.25. If true per-block success is substantially below 2^-48*0.5247, success_probability 0.39 and time_log2=48.1 fail while any concrete returned collision remains valid.

heuristics.statement: Given a full match, Step 3 of proof.md section 5.4 (with its caps) succeeds with entry-weighted average probability at least pbar = 0.1050 over the four equally likely W5 classes.
heuristics.scope: Step 3 on matched states from the fixed public starting point, with uniformly distributed free chaining words A-4, E-4..E-1.
heuristics.extrapolation: Author Monte Carlo and organizer experiments real-state-completion and fresh-completions (256/256 on one real matched state emitting fresh collisions).
heuristics.limitations: States with real (h0,h1,h2) at an actual rare match are not sampled (~2^46 work). If true Step-3 success given a match is below pbar, the success bound and score fail.
